[Intro: low throat chant, whispered]
Turn around, turn around
Stop running from the shape that follows you down

[Verse 1: rap, fast]
Ten long years I was sprinting with a shadow on my heels
Every mirror in the hallway held a face I couldn't feel
Kept the bedroom light on, kept the radio loud
Kept a smile for my mother and a fight in the crowd
Then an old man at the bus stop said "you're tired, aren't you, son?"
And I laughed till I cried 'cause he saw what I'd done
So I walked to the alley where I knew it would wait
Didn't bring a blade, didn't bring a debate
Held my hand out to the dark like it's an old friend's hand
Said "you lead, I'll follow, help me understand"
It was heavier than iron, it was colder than rain
But it moved like my father, it swayed like my pain
Every step that it took, I was learning the floor
Every fear that I named didn't own me no more

[Hook]
I'm dancing with demons, I'm done with the chase
Spin me in circles, I'll look at your face
The thing that I fled had my eyes all along
Dancing with demons, I'm learning their song

[Drop]

[Bridge: chanted]
Slower, closer

[Verse 2: rap]
Now the shame wants the lead and the anger wants the beat
Grief sits by the speaker with her shoes off her feet
Guilt keeps stepping on my toes, so I teach him to turn
Every burn on my skin is a lesson I earned
They don't vanish when you face them, they just shrink to your size
Like a monster in the closet when you open your eyes
I was scared of the silence, now I'm leading the dance
Gave my demons a name and I gave them a chance
Hold 'em close, hold 'em closer, till the panic goes thin
You can't win against a war that you won't let in

[Final Hook]
I'm dancing with demons, I'm done with the chase
Spin me in circles, I'll look at your face
The thing that I fled had my eyes all along
Dancing with demons, I'm learning their song

[Outro: whispered]
Look in the mirror
Who were you running from?
Only me

drops.lyrics:
[Intro]
Locked inside the mind, can you outrun your own shadow?

[Verse 1]
I've been running from ghosts in the back of my head, I don't know how to break
Every decision I made in the dark is a permanent scar that I'm forced to take
Looking for peace in the middle of it all, got my back to the wall and my hands on the flame
Nobody gave me a map to the top, I was buried alive and came out of the grave
Pain is inside of the ache when I ride, I've been sharpening blades in the dead of the night
Cut through the noise and the fake and the lies, you can see the vendetta reflecting my eyes
Heartbeat is faster, a hundred and fifty, the blood in my veins is beginning to boil
Everything built from the dirt and the pain, I've been watering roots in the venomous soil
No way to hide when the curtains are drawn
We're dancing with demons, still cornered, still gone

[Hook]
Can you feel the madness rise?

[Drop]
Run faster, deeper

[Verse 2]
Pacing the floor in a cage of my making, the paranoia got me wide awake
Shaking, they wanted me broken, they wanted me quiet
I walked in the room and I started a riot
No ceiling, no limits, no holding me back when I snap on the beat
Every syllable hidden like hell on the glass, I'm erasing the memories stuck in the past
Look at the hunger, look at the drive, takes a little insanity just to survive
Out of the ashes, I'm taking the throne, I've been fighting these shadows quietly alone
Now the bass is erupting, the ceiling caves in
And the chaos is the only thing keeping me sane
Watch all the doubt and the guilt in the acid, I drown every drop of the rage in the rain

[Outro]
Look in the mirror
Who are you running from?
There is no escape
Lose your mind
The silence is loud
